claims.value: 16 DIA whole-tissue and laser-microdissected regions from one recurrent metastatic melanoma case.
claims.evidence: The publication defines the 24-year-old female case and the PT/PTS, LT/LS/LN and B/BS spatial-region abbreviations; RAW names identify each acquisition.

limitations: This single-patient case study has no independent biological replication.
Fixed search tolerances, isolation-window width and a scalar collision energy are not explicit in the accessible record.
